measure_description: Measured with utils/measure script on a single lamp, using a resistive dummy load (~8.4 W, calibrated warm at 6434.83 ohm) because the power meter drops to 0.0 W below ~0.8 W. Residual scatter around the smoothed curve is sigma 0.042 W. Note that below brightness ~30 the true increment per step (~0.017 W) is smaller than that scatter, so the lowest ~12 % of the table is noise-dominated and not strictly monotonic; the rest resolves cleanly (bri 60-120: +0.32 W = 7.7 sigma, bri 120-255: +1.50 W = 36 sigma).
name: Hue White Filament Candle E14
